name: Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme for Scheduled Castes & Others
provider: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India (via States/UTs)

rules.quote: The students should be studying in class IX and X on a full time basis.
Students should belong to Scheduled Caste.
Their Parent/Guardian's income should not exceed Rs. 2.50 lakh per annum.
The students should be studying in classes I to X on a full time basis
irrespective of their caste/religion belong to one of the following categories
The Scheme is available for students pursuing studies in India only

amount.text: Rs 3,500 (day scholar) / Rs 7,000 (hosteller) per annum, component 1; Rs 8,000 class III-X component 2

documents.name: Certificate of parent's occupation (component 2)
documents.quote: submit a certificate from District Social Welfare officer/ identified officer of Local body/ Civic Agency

deadline.text: Applications invited on NSP in April every year, then on State portal
deadline.quote: The applications will be invited on National Scholarship Portal (NSP) (https://scholarships.gov.in/) in the month of April every year
